panels.title: 3. Triage latency by provider and outcome
4. Fallback rate — the health of the thesis
panels.description: The single most important panel in this system: what fraction of triage calls ended in rules:fallback. This is the number that answers 'does the system fall over when the classifier is rate-limited, slow, or wrong?' It should stay near zero under normal operation and rise visibly during a provider outage without ever producing a 500.

panels.title: 6. Replicas vs CPU utilisation (Kubernetes only — not reproducible from compose)
panels.description: This panel needs kube-state-metrics/cAdvisor and the HPA's own CPU-utilisation series, which only exist on a real Kubernetes cluster (see docs/evidence/hpa-replicas-vs-load.png for the real, live-captured equivalent from Gate 7's k6 run against k3d). Disclosed honestly as out of scope for this compose-based Grafana instance rather than faked with a placeholder query that would return no data.

options.content: **Not reproducible from compose.** This panel requires `kube_pod_container_resource_requests` + the HPA's own CPU metric, both Kubernetes-only. See `docs/evidence/hpa-replicas-vs-load.png` for the real, live equivalent captured against k3d during Gate 7 (offered load vs ready replicas vs CPU utilisation, with the 60% HPA target line drawn).
